 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Amit Mahajan
 Order

The present petition is filed by the petitioner seeking quashing of FIR No. 575/2022 dated 12.09.2022, registered at Police Station Neb Sarai for the offences under Sections 498A/406/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 ('IPC'), including the proceedings emanating therefrom, on the grounds of settlement.
3. The learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State accepts notice.

4. Status report, if any, be filed before the next date of hearing.
5. Issue notice to the respondent no.2 through all permissible, returnable on 22.01.2026.
AMIT MAHAJAN, J DECEMBER 19, 2025/DU
